notes_for_editor: Only the list line names this tower. Two WebSearch calls found no source for O'Barr. The business directory's Dodge County Lookout Tower at 126 Jim Harp Rd., Eastman may or may not be this structure; the address was not geolocated and the list coordinates (32.0574, -83.13098) were not checked against it. The directory points to gfc.state.ga.us, which was not fetched; check Georgia Forestry Commission records before linking the two. Dodge County's other list entries, 'dodge' (GA135) and 'chester' (GA136), are separate points and already have their own records (us-ga-dodge, us-ga-chester).
